OTP-ScoutIMAP accounts & detection rules

Local HTTP endpoint to show codes and links from outside, e.g. from a Tampermonkey script. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only; every request needs the token.

Only links starting with one of these are shown, e.g. https://claude.ai/magic-link. Empty list = any https:// link is accepted.

Endpoints

Code
POST /api/otp/code {"code": "…", "ruleName": "…"}
Link
POST /api/otp/link {"link": "…", "ruleName": "…"}

Proton Mail Bridge: server 127.0.0.1, port 1143, STARTTLS, accept self-signed certificate, and the bridge password shown in the Bridge app. Codes arrive up to ~40 s late – the Bridge polls Proton only every 20–40 s.

    

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

    

    

      
      
    

    

      
      
      
Comma-separated, * = any text. Empty = mails from any sender are checked.

    

    


    

      
Detects a code and shows it large for copying. The code is taken from the subject if it contains {code}, otherwise from the body – which is only downloaded when sender/subject already match. Rules are checked in order; the first match wins.

      

      
    


    

      
Detects a login link (e.g. a magic link) in the body and offers it for opening. The body is only downloaded when sender/subject already match.

      

      
    


    

      
Preconfigured rules for common services, loaded from the OTP-Scout catalog on GitHub. + adds the rules of the selected language to this account; they then appear under code or link rules and can be adjusted there.
